description: This file implements the FrameRate plugin class in C++, managing frame rate data collection, interfacing with device hardware, and handling IARM bus events related to display frame rate changes. It provides methods for starting/stopping FPS collection, setting/getting frame modes, and notifying externally about FPS updates and display rate changes.

classes.name: FrameRate
classes.description: A plugin class responsible for managing frame rate collection, configuration, and notifications in a WPEFramework environment.

methods.name: setCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Sets the fps collection interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: startFpsCollection
methods.description: Starts collecting fps values at configured intervals, initializing metrics and timers.

methods.name: stopFpsCollection
methods.description: Stops fps collection timer, calculates aggregate metrics if updates were received, and disables collection.

methods.name: updateFps
methods.description: Updates internal metrics with a new fps measurement, adjusting min/max/total values.

methods.name: setFrmMode
methods.description: Sets the frame mode of the video device based on provided parameter.

methods.name: getFrmMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current frame mode of the video device.

methods.name: setDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Sets the display frame rate on the device.

methods.name: getDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Gets the current display frame rate from the device.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, including IARM bus event registration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters events, and resets singleton instance.
